say:1:1033515001:1.text: After the Lucent Tree was corrupted, the forest has been a mess.
say:1:1033515001:1.source_cn: 流荧树被腐化后，丛林的子民乱成一团。
say:1:1033515001:1.male: After the Lucent Tree was corrupted, the forest has been a mess.
say:1:1033515001:1.female: After the Lucent Tree was corrupted, the forest has been a mess.

say:2:1033515002:1.text: I must stay here and help where I can.
say:2:1033515002:1.source_cn: 我只能守在流荧树附近，尽力安抚他们。
say:2:1033515002:1.male: I must stay here and help where I can.
say:2:1033515002:1.female: I must stay here and help where I can.

say:3:1033515003:1.text: I hope that when you find Arden, the old man has some good news for us!
say:3:1033515003:1.source_cn: 希望你们找到雅顿时，那老头子能有点好消息！
say:3:1033515003:1.male: I hope that when you find Arden, the old man has some good news for us!
say:3:1033515003:1.female: I hope that when you find Arden, the old man has some good news for us!
